decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The information shown on the submitted drawings, numbers 36425/TR/001, 002, 003, and 004 are considered to be acceptable in showing that vehicles would be able to load and unloading within the site, and turn clear of the highway, in line with Policies T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments), and (T.2.2 Pedestrian Safety and Security), of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Following approval for demolition of the existing (former) London Transport Sports Pavilion and erection of new sports and social clubhouse with tied-caretaker accommodation at first floor level, together with reinstatement of bowling green, 3 tennis courts and 1 netball court, new 44 space car park, looped foothpath access to open space with new access to Great West Road details submitted pursuant to Condition 34 (loading, unloading and turning of vehicles) of planning permission reference 00505/CH/P6 dated 15/03/2004.
